title: relay_queue: SmtpRelayQueue doc says permanent failure marks peer down — wrong after round 3
description: Lines 43-47 of relay_queue.rs say: 'Permanent failure: files moved to dead/, peer is marked down.' After round 3, Permanent(5xx content rejection) does NOT mark the peer down — only marks_peer_down() variants do. Doc contradicts implementation, misleading any operator debugging retry behavior.
